models._note: primary = unity-brain: Unity's own text LoRA (Qwen3.5-9B, Backrooms/models/unity-brain) trained to call say(text, emotion, act) with the exact emotions and speech acts unity-voice-v2 knows; it also reads images, so it is the vision model too. fallback = huihui_ai/qwen3-abliterated:8b (uncensored + native tools; plain text streams to the voice with inferred emotion). Always send unity-brain num_ctx 32768 (models.options). image = her own local image engine (the image block below): the realistic-vision-v51 checkpoint the stream renders with, through services/image_sidecar.py; no hosted image API, no key.

boot._note: popups: show the screenshot / camera / generated-image result windows during boot (off: results are logged and spoken; the 1280x720 capture window over the app looked like CORA reopening smaller).

assistant._note: voice_mode: auto = say_tool for unity-brain (she speaks through the say tool with her own designators), stream for any other model (sentences streamed to the voice as they arrive). legacy_regex: route typed input through the old regex command chain instead of the dispatcher.

image._note: Her own image engine: local Stable Diffusion (services/image_sidecar.py) on the interpreter that has torch + diffusers (python: null = auto-detect, the voice sidecar's interpreter first). device auto = GPU when there is one; offload keeps the model in RAM and streams layers to the GPU so her brain and voice keep their room. steps null = 25 on GPU / 12 on CPU. Pictures land in save_dir and open in the viewer (Save As / Open folder); save_image puts them where the user says.

camera._note: index: auto (probes 0,1,2) or a number; backend: auto (Windows dshow->msmf->any, Linux v4l2->any, macOS avfoundation->any) or one of dshow/msmf/v4l2/avfoundation/any; open_timeout: seconds per open attempt before a stalled device (e.g. a phone-camera virtual webcam with no stream) is given up on for the session.
